job: Narrow a table or list by many fields from one Filter button, and see each filter that is set as a chip.
purpose: One button opens a menu whose search finds fields and values at once; each field opens a panel of values (one, many, a date preset or range, text that the item contains, or a flag) with counts. What is set shows as chips that read as a sentence: the operator flips is and is not, the value reopens its panel. With data-fd-for it hides the rows itself. On a phone the menu is a bottom sheet in two steps.
useWhen: A table or list has more than three fields to filter by: status, endpoint, key, owner, priority, labels, date.
People need several filters at once and must see and change each one in place.
A filtered view should be sharable: data-fd-url keeps the set in the address.

avoidWhen.when: Three fields or fewer that people change all the time.
A public listing such as a blog or a changelog.
Free-text search is the only way to narrow the list.
A list of actions on a row or a page.

states.name: empty
states.how: nothing set: the button alone, no chips, Clear hidden

states.name: set
states.how: aria-checked="true" on values (or a text input's value attribute); chips appear and the button shows the count

states.name: negated
states.how: data-op="not" on a one or many field's item; the chip reads is not

states.name: open
states.how: the menu or a panel has data-state="open"; the button or chip value has aria-expanded="true"

states.name: searching
states.how: a query in the menu's search: matching fields and values as flat results, or one quiet line when nothing matches

states.name: no match
states.how: with data-fd-for, every item hidden: the target's [data-fd-none] shows, with a .fd-filters-clear button

states.name: phone
states.how: below 640px the button opens .fd-filters-sheet: fields, then one field's values with a back button

variants.useWhen: On fd-filters-add in a tight toolbar: the icon alone with aria-label; the count becomes a badge. Put the chip list on the row below with data-fd-filters.

parts.role: The root: data-fd-for, data-fd-url, data-fd-key and data-now; holds the button, the chips and the menu.
The Filter button (an fd-btn that opens the menu); shows the count and the key.
The menu of fields (an fd-menu), with a search at the top and fields in groups.
A field's values (an fd-menu sub-menu), or a text field's input.
The search row at the top of the menu or of a long panel.
A value's count, tabular; in the button, how many filters are set.
The chips: one fd-filter-token per field that is set.
A chip's operator: a button that flips is and is not, or plain text.
A chip's value: a button that reopens the field's panel.
Removes every filter; hidden while none is set.
The phone form: a bottom fd-sheet holding the menu, then one field's values.
The sheet's button back from a field's values to the fields.

keyboard.does: Opens the menu from anywhere outside a text field (data-fd-key changes it); listed in the shortcut sheet.
Searches fields and values at once; Enter takes the first result.

keyboard.keys: Arrow Up, Arrow Down, Home, End
keyboard.does: Move through fields or values; Arrow Up from the first returns to the search.
Opens a field's values; Enter or Space sets a value.
Back to the fields (Backspace from an empty panel search); Escape clears a search, then closes and returns focus.
